CustomField.description: Point of Sale entry, how we describe the card use for chargebacks
CustomField.formula: IF( OR( Card_Method__c = 'CONTACTLESS',Card_Method__c = 'SWIPE'),'PayWave', IF( OR( Card_Method__c = 'CHIP',Card_Method__c = 'ONLINE',Card_Method__c = 'DIGITAL',Card_Method__c = 'IN_APP'),'Card and Pin', IF( OR( Card_Method__c = 'CARD_ON_FILE',Card_Method__c = 'MANUAL'),'Online','N/A' ) ) )
CustomField.label: POS Entry Mode
